---
title: "Sources and licences"
---

Music we use as transcription material, with its provenance. Lesson 42 covers
how we build this list and what to check before adding to it.

Public domain status differs by country, and a modern typeset edition of an old
work can carry its own copyright even when the music itself is free. Record the
edition, not only the composer.

## Where to look

| Source | What it holds | Watch for |
|---|---|---|
| [IMSLP](https://imslp.org/) | Scanned scores, mostly pre-1929 | Editions vary in quality and in licence |
| [Mutopia](https://www.mutopiaproject.org/) | Typeset public-domain scores | Small catalogue, clean licensing |
| [MuseScore](https://musescore.com/) | Community arrangements | Licences vary per upload, many are not free |
